references.text: Moses carried out the command and assembled the congregation at the entrance of the tent of meeting, directly fulfilling the instruction in verse 3.
Parallel text concerning the consecration of Aaron and his sons, where they were also to be brought to the entrance of the tent of meeting.
At the consecration of the Levites, the entire congregation of Israel was also gathered, showing a recurring pattern for public consecration.
Reference to gathering the congregation at the entrance of the tent of meeting using trumpets.
Moses received the command to assemble the congregation; the same Hebrew expression (הַקְהֵל) is used.
Earlier command to bring Aaron and his sons to the entrance of the tent of meeting for washing.
